title: repo-guardian Helm chart values
description: Subset of values.yaml that is enforced at `helm install`/`helm upgrade` time. IMPL-0016 added schema-level rejection of the removed memory / ticker backend identifiers so operators see schema errors at chart-render time instead of pod CrashLoopBackoff.

workerCount.description: REMOVED in chart 2.0.0 (IMPL-0025): use worker.concurrency. See docs/operations/v2-migration.md#removed-chart-values.

queueSize.description: REMOVED in chart 2.0.0 (IMPL-0025): there is no in-process queue. See docs/operations/v2-migration.md#removed-chart-values.

scheduleInterval.description: REMOVED in chart 2.0.0 (IMPL-0025): use checkInterval. See docs/operations/v2-migration.md#removed-chart-values.

maxJobAttempts.description: REMOVED in chart 2.0.0 (IMPL-0025): Temporal retry policies bound attempts. See docs/operations/v2-migration.md#removed-chart-values.

backend.description: Persistent state store backend. Only "postgres" is supported since IMPL-0016 (chart 1.0).

queue.description: REMOVED in chart 2.0.0 (IMPL-0025): the Valkey work queue is replaced by Temporal. See docs/operations/v2-migration.md#removed-chart-values.

scheduler.description: REMOVED in chart 2.0.0 (IMPL-0025): Temporal Schedules replace the Valkey leader-elected scheduler. See docs/operations/v2-migration.md#removed-chart-values.

discovery.description: Repository discovery (IMPL-0015 Phase 1) — periodic enumeration of installations + repos via the GitHub API into Store.UpsertIfMissing.

posture.description: Compliance posture export (IMPL-0023 / DESIGN-0022) — the leader projects rule_state onto the posture gauges.

exportInterval.description: REMOVED in chart 2.0.0 (IMPL-0025): the posture gauges are gone; the API reads compliance from Postgres. See docs/operations/v2-migration.md#removed-chart-values.

snapshotInterval.description: Go duration (e.g. "24h"). Cadence of compliance-history rows for `repo-guardian report --since`. Rows are permanent; there is no retention machinery.

tailscale.description: REMOVED in IMPL-0024 (chart 1.0.0): ingress is operator-owned — the baked Tailscale sidecar was deleted. See docs/operations/ingress.md#migrating-from-the-baked-sidecar.

webhookIPAllowlist.description: REMOVED in IMPL-0024 (chart 1.0.0): the in-app IP allowlist middleware was deleted; source-IP enforcement lives at the operator's edge layer. See docs/operations/ingress.md#migrating-from-the-baked-sidecar.

staleSweep.description: REMOVED in chart 2.0.0 (IMPL-0025): each RepoWorkflow schedules its own next check (checkInterval); the v1 backfill freshness moved to migrate.freshness. See docs/operations/v2-migration.md#removed-chart-values.

topology.description: Deployment shape: split (one Deployment per role) or all (one Deployment).
